caveat: The deployed-confinement verdicts in this probe are NOT representative of the real worker runtime: the probe mounts the workspace as a bind mount at /w and runs the image's default user, and even the in-scope control read (c8) was denied by the deployed confinement. The CI native-Linux drill (run 44882932634, at 19f5cae) proves in-scope write+read through the same mechanism works on the real worker path. The decision-layer rows (deny/allow before execution) are exact; treat the deployed EXECUTION rows as probe observations, not product truth.
dispositionSummary: The deployed tag vw24b1 predates the A-01 argument checks (added at e24b830, 2026-11-14). Four argument-trick negatives (c3-c6) pass the deployed decision layer; c3 demonstrates an executed read of a system file outside the workspace. HEAD denies all four with OUT_OF_SCOPE, pinned by 25 argument tests + scope-edge tests + the real-boundary suite. Closing the deployed-tag gap = redeploy a newer tag set (owner A-06 action); the code-side A-01 surface is closed at HEAD.
confidence: deployed decision-layer rows: exact (in-image run). head rows: exact (decision layer, real workspace, same shapes as the pinned tests). deployed execution rows: probe-only (see caveat).
